name: io.github.whosman/frontofgoal
title: Front of Goal
description: Football (soccer) odds from prediction markets: matches, kickoff, venue, futures and bet links.

tools.name: find_matches
tools.description: Find football (soccer) matches and their current market odds by team, league, or both. Returns each match's kickoff time (UTC), status, home/draw/away probabilities, a match_id and its frontofgoal.com page. Use it for questions like "when do Arsenal play next?", "what Premier League games are on this weekend?" or "what's on today?". With no team or league it lists the most-traded matches. Use when "recent" for results from the last three days.

team.description: A team name as people say it, e.g. "Arsenal", "Man Utd", "Real Madrid", "PSG".

league.description: A league or cup: its id from list_leagues (e.g. "premier-league"), its name ("La Liga") or a common short name ("EPL", "UCL", "MLS").

when.description: Time window. today and tomorrow are UTC days; live is matches in play; recent is the last three days.

tools.name: get_match_odds
tools.description: Current odds for one football match: home win, draw and away win as implied probabilities and decimal odds from a real-money prediction market, with kickoff time (UTC), venue when known, status, live score while in play, the result once finished, recent form and the match page link. Pass match_id from find_matches, or just a team name to get that team's next match. Prices are live when the market's feed answers (prices_live).

match_id.description: The match: an id from find_matches, list_futures or get_market, or a frontofgoal.com page URL.

team.description: Instead of match_id: a team name, to get that team's next match.

tools.name: list_futures
tools.description: Season-long and tournament markets (futures/outrights) such as league winner, top scorer, relegation, top-four finish or cup winner, with the likeliest outcomes and their implied probabilities. Filter by league and by words in the market title. Use for questions like "who is favourite to win the Premier League?" or "Champions League winner odds".

league.description: A league or cup: its id from list_leagues (e.g. "premier-league"), its name ("La Liga") or a common short name ("EPL", "UCL", "MLS").

query.description: Words in the market title, e.g. "winner", "top scorer", "relegated".

outcomes_per_market.description: Likeliest outcomes to show per market (1 to 10). get_market lists more.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Every outcome of one market with its implied probability, decimal odds and whether it is taking bets: a futures market (e.g. league winner), a side market on a match (exact score, half-time result) or a match itself. Pass a market_id from list_futures, find_matches or get_match_odds. Shows the winner once the market has settled.

market_id.description: The market: an id from find_matches, list_futures or get_market, or a frontofgoal.com page URL.

limit.description: Most outcomes to return, likeliest first (1 to 40).

tools.name: list_leagues
tools.description: Leagues and cups that have open markets, with each one's league_id, number of upcoming matches and futures markets, most active first. Use it to find the right league_id, or to answer "which leagues can I bet on?". Filter with query, e.g. a country or a league name.

query.description: Words in the league name, e.g. "Spain", "Liga", "women".

tools.name: get_trade_link
tools.description: The frontofgoal.com page where the user can place a bet on a match or market, with the current price of the outcome they named. Use it when the user wants to bet, or asks where to bet. The link opens our site; this tool places no bet and moves no money. Spanish (es) and Portuguese (pt) pages exist for single matches.

market_id.description: The match or market: an id from find_matches, list_futures or get_market, or a frontofgoal.com page URL.

outcome.description: Optional: the outcome the user wants, e.g. "Arsenal", "Draw", "Yes" or a player's name.

language.description: Page language: en, es or pt.
